_doc: Policy for scripts/hooks/version-bump-guard.js. The guard refuses (warn or block) git commits that stage framework-prefix files while framework/releases/<version.json#version>/ already has a minted capsule. Forces a version bump before more framework changes can ship.

enforcement._note: Default is warn. Flip to 'block' once the team is comfortable with the friction. An optional soft_rollout_until downgrades 'block' to 'warn' until that date passes; after it, the declared mode is the effective mode.

bypass._note: Both bypass mechanisms log to stderr so misuse is observable.
